description: Production-oriented full-stack bakery and fruit ordering platform for managing customers, products, inventory, carts, orders, payments, wallets and business operations. Includes shopping cart and checkout, role-based access, wallet/debt management, payment integration and admin dashboard.

Interactive personal developer portfolio designed to present projects, skills, experience and developer identity through a modern animated interface. Features interactive 3D visuals, smooth scrolling, AI-style assistant, command palette and responsive UI.

Full-stack research and educational application for classifying breast histopathology image patches as Benign or Malignant using a CancerNet CNN model. Includes image upload, prediction confidence, history tracking and performance dashboard.

Full-stack machine-learning application for predicting insurance purchase outcomes from customer age and estimated salary. Includes JWT authentication, prediction history, model comparison and performance metrics.

AI-powered job marketplace connecting job seekers and recruiters through role-based dashboards, job management, applications, resume processing and intelligent recommendations. Includes AI resume analysis, job matching and skill-gap analysis.

Web-based wild animal detection and alert system — AI-based wildlife image recognition combining Django with computer vision and TensorFlow-based machine learning. Includes image upload, preprocessing, classification and Django web integration.

Role-based college no-due clearance platform that digitizes a multi-department student clearance process. Features JWT authentication, 11-section sequential workflow, role-based routing, audit history and certificate generation.
